review:
Book of Pyramids is one of BGaming's oldest games, from 2016, built on the classic Egyptian theme with hand-drum music and nine paylines. It sticks to traditional features: wilds, scatters and free spins.

Its maths is the main attraction. BGaming lists a 97.13% RTP and medium-high volatility, with a 1,939x maximum, and free spins arrive very often, around once every 57 spins on average. That makes it one of the most bonus-friendly games in the database, even if the ceiling is modest. It's a retro choice that suits long, relaxed demo sessions more than big-win hunting.
pros: Excellent 97.13% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 57 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
